subject: Medford High School Stabbing Incident
overview: News coverage reports on a stabbing inside a Medford High School bathroom that resulted in non-life-threatening injuries to one student and a temporary school lockdown. Police took a juvenile suspect into custody.

items.title: Medford High School Stabbing Report
items.summary: Following a stabbing in a second-floor boys' bathroom that left one student with non-life-threatening injuries, police took a juvenile suspect into custody and lifted a schoolwide lockdown at lunchtime.
